title: Octo Pop
tagline: Type the word, pop the bubble, before it floats away.
help: Type the word inside a bubble to pop it before it reaches the surface. Letters you've typed turn pink, Backspace erases one, and a wrong letter makes Octo wince. Lose all three hearts and the level is lost. Enter or Space starts and continues. On a phone or tablet, type on the keys under the game.
